description: Track V ingest web-source roster — the machine-readable half of .claude/skills/ingest-newsletters/SKILL.md (policy stays in the skill; URLs + fetch mechanics live here). Driven by scripts/fetch-sources.mjs, which snapshots each source and emits .ingest-cache/changes.json so the ingest only spends model attention on sources that actually changed. fetch: "auto" = plain HTTP first, headless-browser fallback; "browser" = known to 403/JS-wall plain fetches. cadence: "monthly" sources are checked on the first Monday run of the month only.

sources.name: Greenpointers front page
sources.notes: "What's Happening" roundup publishes WEDNESDAYS — a diff here surfaces the new post URL; always verify items at the post itself. Apply the Williamsburg-address gate per roundup item. Blocks plain WebFetch.

sources.name: The Carcosa Club
sources.notes: 982 Manhattan Ave; membership waitlist-only but $15/day guest passes + public events. Ignore stale aggregator listings at the closed Williamsburg address. Batu 2026-07-27: use the CALENDAR view — one of the three game-club sources to keep in every scan. His link pinned &month=07-2026; the month param is deliberately dropped here so the scan follows the current month instead of going stale, but that default was NOT verifiable on the run that changed it (network allowlist) — if the calendar comes back empty or stuck, re-add &month=MM-YYYY and rotate it each run.

sources.name: NY Plays
